headline: Catchers and fourth outfielders now: Stephenson went home to Cincinnati, Tyrone Taylor crossed town to the White Sox, and King is the arm everyone is waiting on with six days to the lockout.

news.title: Reds keep Tyler Stephenson: three years, $30 million
news.note: Includes an opt-out after the second year. That leaves Carson Kelly as the last starting catcher on the market.

news.title: Tyrone Taylor goes from the Cubs to the White Sox: two years, $17 million
news.note: A career year (.827 OPS) bought him a platoon role on the South Side. He hit .351 in 30 games as a Cub.

news.title: Corey Seager willing to waive his no-trade clause for the Phillies
news.note: Philadelphia is open to moving Trea Turner off shortstop. Seager is owed $155M through 2031.

news.title: Tigers sign Ha-Seong Kim: one year, $5 million
news.note: A defense-first flier after a .116 season in Atlanta around finger surgery.

news.title: Orioles sign Freddy Peralta: five years, $125 million
news.note: The biggest deal ever for an Orioles pitcher. The ALCS MVP replaces Trevor Rogers, who left for the Cubs.

news.title: Blue Jays land Kaima Taira: five years, $80 million
news.note: NPB's ERA leader (1.36) gets an opt-out after year three.
